cards.ex: With the economy slowing down, we need to tighten the purse strings at home.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot sekinlashgani sababli, uyda xarajatlarni qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Pul sarflashni kamaytirish, xarajatlarni nazoratga olish.

cards.ex: It's always wise to have a rainy day fund in case of emergencies.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda vaziyatlar uchun qora kun uchun jamg'arma bo'lishi doimo aqlli.

cards.ex: We're saving up for a down payment on a mortgage.
cards.exUz: Biz ipoteka uchun dastlabki to'lovga pul yig'yapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Uy sotib olish uchun olingan bank krediti.

cards.ex: The bank offered a low interest rate on the car loan.
cards.exUz: Bank avtomobil krediti bo'yicha past foiz stavkasini taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kredit yoki depozit bo'yicha to'lanadigan foiz miqdori.

cards.ex: It's important to maintain a good credit score to get approved for loans.
cards.exUz: Kreditlar uchun tasdiqlanish uchun yaxshi kredit reytingini saqlash muhim.

cards.ex: They were living beyond their means and quickly accumulated debt.
cards.exUz: Ular imkonidan ortiq yashashdi va tezda qarzga botishdi.

cards.ex: It's hard work, but we're determined to get out of debt.
cards.exUz: Bu qiyin ish, lekin biz qarzdorlikdan qutulishga qaror qildik.

cards.ex: Ever since he sold his company, he's been rolling in dough.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyasini sotganidan beri, u pulga to'lib-toshgan.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the renovation costs?
cards.exUz: Ta'mirlash xarajatlari uchun taxminiy raqamni ayta olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Aniqlik darajasi past bo'lgan taxminiy summa.

cards.ex: I had to bail my brother out when his business failed.
cards.exUz: Uning biznesi muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganda, men akamga yordam berishga majbur bo'ldim.

cards.ex: That bonus will make a dent in my credit card debt.
cards.exUz: Bu bonus mening kredit karta qarzimga ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir ozgina bo'lsada ta'sir qilmoq (odatda xarajat)

cards.ex: My uncle is so tight-fisted, he never tips.
cards.exUz: Amakim juda zichnafas, u hech qachon choychaqa bermaydi.

cards.ex: I'm a bit hard up at the moment, could I borrow some money?
cards.exUz: Hozir biroz qiyin ahvoldaman, biroz pul qarzga olsam bo'ladimi?

cards.ex: That new car must have cost an arm and a leg.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi mashina juda qimmatga tushgan bo'lishi kerak.
cards.term: cost an arm and a leg

cards.ex: He's always trying to find ways to make a quick buck.
cards.exUz: U doimo tez pul ishlash yo'llarini topishga harakat qiladi.

cards.ex: The company is struggling to balance the books this quarter.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ushbu chorakda balansni muvozanatlash uchun kurashmoqda.

cards.ex: We had to pay through the nose for flights during the holidays.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'til paytida reyslar uchun juda ko'p pul to'lashimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir uchun juda qimmat narxda to'lamoq.

cards.ex: Having savings provides a financial cushion in case of job loss.
cards.exUz: Jamg'armalarga ega bo'lish, ishsizlik holatida moliyaviy himoya beradi.

cards.ex: The company was debt-ridden and on the verge of bankruptcy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya qarzga botgan edi va bankrotlik yoqasida edi.

cards.ex: My parents are footing the bill for my college education.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam mening kollejdagi ta'limim uchun xarajatlarni to'lashadi.

cards.ex: Your first drink is on the house!
cards.exUz: Sizning birinchi ichimligingiz bepul!

cards.ex: We opened a line of credit to cover unexpected expenses.
cards.exUz: Biz kutilmagan xarajatlarni qoplash uchun kredit liniyasini ochdik.
cards.uzDef: Kredit kartaga o'xshash qarz olish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: A new car is beyond our budget this year.
cards.exUz: Yangi mashina bu yil byudjetimizdan tashqari.

cards.ex: That product has become a real cash cow for the company.
cards.exUz: Bu mahsulot kompaniya uchun haqiqiy daromad manbaiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy daromad keltiradigan biznes yoki mahsulot.

cards.ex: We had to dip into our savings to pay for the repairs.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'mirlash uchun jamg'armamizdan pul sarflashga majbur bo'ldik.

cards.ex: We barely managed to break even this year.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yil zo'rg'a nolga tenglasha oldik.
cards.uzDef: Xarajat va daromad teng bo'lmoq, foyda olmaslik.

cards.ex: He received a generous golden handshake when he retired.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqqanida saxiy nafaqa oldi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan ketayotganda beriladigan katta miqdordagi pul.

cards.ex: We are strapped for cash until payday.
cards.exUz: Biz ish haqi kunigacha pulga muhtojmiz.

cards.ex: It's important to be fiscally responsible and save for the future.
cards.exUz: Moliyaviy mas'uliyatli bo'lish va kelajak uchun jamg'arish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Pulni to'g'ri boshqarish, oqilona xarajat qilish.

cards.ex: She really hit the jackpot when she won the lottery.
cards.exUz: U lotereyada yutib, haqiqatan ham omadi chopdi.
